why: `isPauseHotkey` treats a focused button as a control that consumes Escape and P. With Back restoring focus to the Controllers button on the pause panel, this is the mutation under which the second Escape -- the one that should resume -- does nothing.
killedBy: hud: navigation layers -- origin, Back and focus restoration (issue #318) Controllers opened from PAUSED returns to paused, focuses the Controllers button, and the narrowed pause hotkey accepts that target
isPauseHotkey accepts Escape and P aimed at a focused SLIDER, which consumes only the keys that move it (issue #494)
isPauseHotkey accepts a key aimed at a focused BUTTON, which consumes Space and Enter and nothing else (issue #318)
